profile.summary: PMP-certified project manager with eight years leading IT and operations projects of up to $4M for health care and logistics companies. Comfortable with both Agile and waterfall teams.

descriptions: Led a $4M patient scheduling system rollout across 14 clinics with a 22-person team; went live on schedule and 6% under budget
Set up the project intake process and status reporting that the PMO now uses for about 30 projects a year
Run weekly risk reviews with IT, clinical and finance leads and report status to the executive steering committee
Coach three junior project managers on scheduling, vendor contracts and stakeholder updates
Managed the move of two warehouses to a new management system with no missed shipments during cutover
Delivered 11 Agile releases of the carrier portal with a team of eight developers in two-week sprints
Negotiated the scope and payment schedule with the software vendor and kept change orders under 5% of contract value
Tracked on-time delivery for 120 carriers and built the weekly scorecard used in carrier reviews
